description: Perlica (P5, Wild Wanderer, Mordvolt Insulation) with Estella (the build of fixtures/zmdlogs-4e5e1390085e.json) vs Rhodagn, Perlica controlled and her ultimate charged. Estella's battle skill inflicts Cryo; Perlica's battle skill adds Electric, which consumes it: an Electrification reaction, P3's first ATK layer (on that hit already) and Wild Wanderer's team Physical and Electric DMG (from the next hit on). Her basic chain ends in a Final Strike, which opens her combo window; the combo forces Electrification I for 8.75 s (P1) at ×1.33 strength (P4), replacing the reaction's, and adds P3's second layer before its own hit. Her ultimate a second later (P5: crit rate +30%) lands under both layers and the stronger Electrification.
